text: Put Deck between Pier1 and Pier2. Connect Cable to Deck. Make Cable navy. Is Deck bigger than Cable?
Hub controls Lamp, Sensor and Fan. Make Hub indigo. Which shape has the fewest connections? Is there a path from Sensor to Lamp? Thanks.
Lay out the notes in a row, C first. Connect C to D, D to E, and E to G in a chain. Make G gold.
Move Fridge to the far right. Align Oven and Stove on the horizontal axis. Is Sink below Oven? Thanks.
Qb goes to Rb, then Rb goes to Wr1. Wr1 and Wr2 are both on the right side. Make the Qb huge. Which one is the rightmost? Also, can you list all the circles?
Bring King to the front. Send Ace to the back. Make Queen blue.
From now on rectangles are blue. Connect Welcome to Signup, Signup to Verify and Verify to Home. Which shapes are linked to Verify?
Make all the red circles small. Is there any blue shape? Which shape is the leftmost one?
Arrange the tiles in a grid. Show me the shapes that are not blue.
Make Lift white. Move Stairs to the left of Lift. Which shape is the biggest?
Duplicate Room1 twice. Is Room2 red? Rename Room3 to Board.
Connect Pick to Pack, Pack to Label, and Label to Dispatch with dotted lines. Put Dispatch at the bottom right. What is the degree of Pack?
Put Roses to the right of Entrance. Cacti goes below Roses. Make Ferns lime. Which shape is closest to Entrance?
Connect Keynote to Panel, Panel to Break and Break to Lunch. Disconnect Break from Lunch, the lunch is a separate event. Is Keynote directly linked to Lunch?
Move Cafe to the bottom left. Make Hall2 small. Show me all the rectangles that are red.
AndGate and OrGate both go to Out. Make Out a yellow star. What's the color of OrGate?
Connect them in that order, Warm, Lift, Cool, Stretch. Make Stretch small. Disconnect Cool from Stretch, I'll reconnect later.
Dev1 and Dev2 sit below Lead. Lead sits below Boss. Connect Boss to Lead. Connect Lead to Dev1 and Dev2.
Link Shop to Stop1, Stop2 and Stop3. Which stop is nearest to the Shop?
Make Fixed green. Rename Open to Reported. Which shapes are gray?
Put Chord2 between Chord1 and Chord3, that's the correct order. Make Chord1 small.
Connect PipeA to PipeB with arrows both ways, I mean two-way.
Arrange Start, Middle and End in a row. Distribute them horizontally. Show me the position of Middle.
Swap Piece1 and Piece2. Then swap them back, actually.
Gran sits at the top. Dad and Mum go beneath her. Kids goes to the bottom.
Connect Battery to Resistor to Bulb, and then connect Bulb back to Battery. Is there a cycle?
Move About to the right of Home, Contact to the right of About.
Make all the shapes that are not green huge.
Score is blue. Make Result huge. Connect Start to Score and Score to Result.
Describe Legend for me. Is Title above Legend? Put Scale at the bottom right.
Connect Mon1, Tue1 and Wed1 each to the next. Make Wed1 orange.
Make Mirror large and gray. Put Rack beside Bench1. Are there any shapes that are not gray?
Connect Paris to Rome, Rome to Cairo, Cairo to Dubai. Is there a path from Paris to Dubai? Make Dubai huge.
Align Img1, Img2, Img3, Img4 and Img5 on the vertical axis. Then distribute them vertically.
Start with Jump, then Tunnel, then Weave, then Finish. Connect them in order. Is Finish reachable from Jump?
Make Box1 square.
Connect Ring to Snooze and Snooze to Off, dashed please. Is Off reachable from Ring?
Put Card1, Card2, Card3 and Card4 in a row. Then make Card4 gold.
Budget splits into Food, Rent and Fun. Connect Budget to Food, Rent and Fun. Make Fun pink. Which shape has the most connections?
Connect Hook, Lesson, Practice and Quiz each to the next. Make Quiz a diamond.

I'm sketching the main screens of a photo sharing app and I need the navigation to make sense. Login leads to Feed. Feed should connect to Post and Profile. Put Settings at the top right, that's where people expect it. Logout should be near Settings. Make Login green since it's the start. Make Post huge, it's the main action. Connect Profile to Settings, and Settings to Logout. Is there a path from Login to Logout? Which shape is the most connected? Hmm, describe the whole thing for the readme. Undo the last change if the layout looks weird. Thanks, the team will review it Monday.

Hi! My group is building a diagram for the volcano science fair. Magma rises into the Vent. Connect Vent to Lava, and Lava to Ash. Ash falls onto the Crust. Make Magma red. Hmm, Lava should be the bright one, so make Lava yellow instead. Is the Vent bigger than the Crust? Move the Crust below the Magma. Add a small gray circle named Smoke above the Vent. Which shape has the most connections? Duplicate Ash two times. Thanks, our judge is a geologist.

I'm sketching the parking lot for the mall, the planners want a clear picture. Entry is at the bottom, the cars come in from the road. Arrange Row1, Row2 and Row3 in a column. Put Booth between Entry and Row1. Connect Entry to Booth and Booth to Row1. Exit goes to the top right corner. Make Booth yellow so it is easy to see. Is Row2 below Row1? Move Row3 below Row2 if it is not. Which shape has the least connections? Rename Booth to Ticket. Also, is there a path from Entry to Row3? Duplicate Row1 once for the second row of spaces. How many shapes do we have now? Thanks, the planners meet Thursday.

Working on the story flow for our pitch deck, slides are boxes. Problem comes first, then Solution, then Market. Connect those three in a chain. Team goes after Market, and Ask is the last slide. Connect Market to Team and Team to Ask. Make Ask gold because it is the money slide. Is Team left of Ask? Shrink Problem a bit, it's too heavy. Which shape has the most connections? Move Team to the right of Market. Rename Ask to Funding. Thanks, I'll show it to my cofounder tonight.

My daughter has a science fair on Friday and we're making her poster diagram on this canvas. Plant is in the middle, Water and Sun are on either side. Move Water to the left of Plant. Move Sun to the right of Plant. Connect Water to Plant and Sun to Plant, with arrows. Make Plant green, it is the thing we are growing. Chart should be near Table. Is Chart bigger than Plant? Hmm, make Chart a bit bigger, resize it. What's the leftmost shape? Put the Table at the bottom center. Undo the last move if the sun went to the wrong side. Thanks, you are very patient with us.

Our tabletop campaign map needs a cleanup before session. The Castle is on the top of Mountain? Put Castle above Mountain. Connect Village to Forest and Forest to Cave. Connect Mountain to Village with a dotted link, that is the river route. Make Cave black. Is there a path from Village to Castle? Which shape is closest to Village? Duplicate Forest three times for new forests. Rename River to Stream. Show me all the black shapes. Thanks, the players will love it.
Move Cake above Table. Balloon goes above Cake. Gift goes near Table. Is Balloon above Cake?
Connect Story to Page1 and Page1 to Page2. Make Page2 pink. How many shapes do we have?
Rocket is huge.
Make the Header medium. Make the Footer tiny. Is the Logo above the Header? Show me the list of all the stars.
